scores.note: Fixed relay posts made the Inka runner system work across one empire, but they are a component of that practice and nothing later rests on them.
Gave one Andean state fast long-distance messaging, a new ability for it, but the system was abandoned and no later line of work descends from it.
A workflow refinement inside Bi Sheng's own workshop method, speeding setting and reuse, with no known users beyond it and no known successors.
One component step of Bi Sheng's method, known from a single workshop account, improving how type was held level, with no independent descendants.
One surviving printed scroll, sealed in a cave and a witness to woodblock printing, not its origin; implies tier 3, below the reviewed tier 2.
First reusable movable type, a new ability little used in its own day, with wooden and metal type in East Asia as successors; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Printing from cast type spread from this system to most of the world, changed how knowledge moved, and became a platform for science, religion, schooling and news.
One surviving volume from one temple's print run, a witness to Korean metal type that already existed; implies tier 3, below the reviewed tier 2.
One woodblock edition of one text, made by a long-established method, changing nothing and with nothing later resting on it.
Made typesetting much faster and newspapers cheaper across many industrial societies, with a few rival and successor machines; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
A new way to print drawn images, music and maps, used across many societies, from which chromolithography and offset printing grew as a line of work.
A consumer tape format with few buyers, a variant of existing digital recording, abandoned in four years; implies tier 3, two below the reviewed tier 1.
MiniDisc was widely used mainly in Japan, improved portable recording over cassette, and had a few successor formats; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Raised aerial and earth connection turned short laboratory signalling into usable wireless telegraphy for ships and stations, and Marconi's whole system line grew from it.
One railway's telegraph installation, improving its own signalling after earlier railway telegraphs existed, with no distinct descendants; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
Made routine same-day communication between Europe and North America possible for commerce, news and diplomacy, followed by further ocean cables on the same pattern.
One cable that worked for weeks and then failed, proving the route possible and informing the 1866 success; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One experimenter's preliminary trials combining known devices, leading directly to the aerial-and-earth apparatus but changing nothing by themselves.
A more sensitive detector of electrical waves, used by early wireless experimenters and operators, on which the first generation of wireless telegraph receivers was built.
One town's exchange, giving its subscribers switched calls for the first time, soon copied elsewhere as similar exchanges opened; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Fibre links came to carry most of the world's telephone and data traffic, reorganised telecommunications around them, and grew a whole field of optical networking.
Brought fast long-distance messaging to the public of one large region, derived from telegraphy elsewhere, with later Indian networks as successors; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One line between two cities, the first electric messaging in Japan and so new to its users, from which the national network followed; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One line opened to paying users between two cities, a new ability for them, extended by later commercial lines; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Tied one Andean empire together for armies, officials and messengers, a reorganising ability for that state, with the chaski relay and colonial routes built on it.
Let Inuit of one region winter and travel on snow and sea ice, a new ability, with nothing later resting on it; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One city's aqueduct branch, one more supply built by a method Roman towns already had, with the Barbegal mills later drawing on its flow.
One city's reservoirs, without which an arid site could not have held a city, with no known later work resting on them; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One duct at one site, improving delivery of stored water to a single building complex, with nothing later known to rest on it.
One inlet channel at one reservoir, a working part that improved how runoff was caught, with no descendants of its own.
One embankment at one capital that formed a reservoir and probably failed soon, leaving no known successors; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
Two outlets of one failed dam, a detail of that single structure, changing nothing lasting and with nothing later resting on them.
One reservoir without which a desert site with no permanent water could not be used, with only its own local works attached; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
One dam at one spring in a well-watered place, repaired after floods, improving local water control by a known method with no known successors.
Made travel on bright snow safer for Arctic peoples of one sparse region, with no later discoveries resting on it; implies tier 3, two below reviewed tier 1.
One company's kettle in a new metal, a variant of an existing household object, followed by a line of aluminium cookware.
One product that replaced animal bristle with cleaner, cheaper nylon for its buyers, and was followed by the nylon brushes other makers adopted.
Knotted-cord accounting let one Andean state track stores without writing, a real administrative ability, but no later line of work rests on it.
Sign-and-number records on clay, a new administrative ability short of full writing, served many Near Eastern societies, and cuneiform writing, law, mathematics and astronomy later stood on them.
First model of a minicomputer family used across laboratories and industry, an improvement on earlier minicomputers, on which Unix and C grew; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One laboratory's machine that gave its researchers a regular computing service, from which subroutine programming practice and LEO grew; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
One model revision of a niche workplace headset, a variant of earlier editions, withdrawn after four years with nothing known to rest on it.
One firm's computer, the first anywhere to do routine office work, a new ability for that firm, followed by later LEO models; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
Junction isolation made monolithic chips manufacturable and was used in chip families that many societies came to depend on, shaping later bipolar circuit lines.
One early chip product sold in small evaluation lots, an advance on discrete circuits, followed by the Micrologic family; implies tier 3, two below reviewed tier 1.
One chip that first put a programmable processor on a single die for equipment makers, a new ability from which the microprocessor line grew.
One laboratory demonstration that a whole circuit could be made in semiconductor, starting the integrated-circuit line; implies tier 2, below reviewed tier 1.
An independent route to the integrated circuit: metal wiring over oxide made chips mass-producible, is used in chips many societies depend on, and the planar chip industry grew from it.
One prototype chip whose isolation method was soon dropped, leading directly to the junction-isolated version and Type F; implies tier 3, below reviewed tier 2.
Scored as the silicon-gate process it introduced, which made chips faster and denser, became the industry standard and underlay memories and microprocessors.
Gave research computing sites across one country working packet networking and remote resource sharing, from which the field of computer networking and internet protocols grew.
